en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 280 - Sulaym bin Qays Hilali has narrated from Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari and Abdullah bin Abbas that

Rasulullah (sw) said in his bequest to Amir al-Mu'mineen (as): “O Ali, soon Quraish would unite against you and they would come together to oppress and defeat you; thus if you have supporters, you should do Jihad against them and if you don’t have any supporters, you must refrain from violence and keep yourself secure; since martyrdom would come to you later.”
